items.title: This Tiny Village Is Picture Perfect, Apart From All the Tourists
items.summary: The residents of Vlkolinec in Slovakia — there are 17 — say that since the place was named a world heritage site, gawking hordes have made it unlivable.

items.imageAlt: Students visiting the “UNESCO House” in Vlkolinec, Slovakia, in June. The village can receive 1,000 visitors a day in peak season.
